import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('cms_program_stats_providers_2023.xlsx', sheet_name='MDCR PROVIDERS 4_CPS_19PRV', header=None)

header_row_idx = None
for idx, row in df.iterrows():
    if row.astype(str).str.contains('Short Stay Hospital Beds', case=False).any():
        header_row_idx = idx
        break

headers = df.iloc[header_row_idx].tolist()
beds_col = None
state_col = 0
for col_idx, val in enumerate(headers):
    if str(val).strip() == 'Short Stay Hospital Beds':
        beds_col = col_idx
        break

data = df.iloc[header_row_idx + 1:].copy()
fl_beds = float(data[data[state_col].astype(str).str.strip() == 'Florida'][beds_col].values[0])
ca_beds = float(data[data[state_col].astype(str).str.strip() == 'California'][beds_col].values[0])

result = 'yes' if fl_beds > ca_beds else 'no'

import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('cms_program_stats_providers_2023.xlsx', sheet_name='MDCR PROVIDERS 2_CPS_19PRV', header=None)
# Look for 'Skilled Nursing Facilities' followed by 'Number of beds' or directly in MDCR PROVIDERS 4_CPS_19PRV
# In Sheet 2:
# r36: Skilled Nursing Facilities
# r37: Number of beds | 2023 is column G (index 6)
row_idx = None
for idx, val in df[0].items():
    if pd.notna(val) and 'skilled nursing facilities' in str(val).lower():
        row_idx = idx
        break

# next row is 'Number of beds'
beds_row = row_idx + 1
result = int(df.iloc[beds_row, 6])

import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('cms_program_stats_providers_2023.xlsx', sheet_name='MDCR PROVIDERS 6_CPS_19PRV', header=None)
# Physician specialties start around row index 8 (r9: Primary Care) to row index 78 (r79)
# 'All Physician Specialties' is at r8 (idx 7)
# 'Non-Physician Practitioners' starts at r80 (idx 79)
start_idx = df[df[0].str.contains('All Physician Specialties', na=False)].index[0] + 1
end_idx = df[df[0].str.contains('Non-Physician Practitioners', na=False)].index[0]

sub_df = df.iloc[start_idx:end_idx].copy()
# Filter out subheadings (which have NaN or non-numeric in column 5/2023)
sub_df['val'] = pd.to_numeric(sub_df[5], errors='coerce')
sub_df = sub_df.dropna(subset=['val'])

top5 = sub_df.sort_values(by='val', ascending=False).head(5)
result = top5[0].tolist()
